rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for someone who is careless or heedless.

example.english: You're so thoughtless that you even forgot to lock the door.

rows.note: Use this when the person fails to consider other people's feelings or needs.

example.english: They knew I was ill and still asked me to work overtime; that was really thoughtless.

rows.note: Use this for a remark, action, or argument that seems unconsidered or produced without thinking, rather than for general lack of care.

example.english: What you just said was really thoughtless.
